text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text:
Phew. That was a tough one.
You sure know your stuff when it comes to monsters, huh, Karyl.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ～
手ごわかったですね～
キャルちゃん、
魔物のことにも詳しいんですね。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Well... I mean, it's just stuff I've heard. That was the first time 
I ever actually saw one. I didn't think that was something you'd 
usually see around here. I wonder if something weird happened?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま……
まぁ聞いた話よ。
実際に見たのは初めてだわ。
こんなところにいるヤツじゃないと思ってたけど……
何か異変でもあったのかしら？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text:
Who cares? We've got a huge catch for tonight! *giggle* 
I'm really looking forward to dinner! I wonder what I should eat first?
The belly? Or the collar? Or maybe the fins?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしても、
今夜は大漁ですね♪
うふふっ、
晩御飯が楽しみです！
　どこからがいいですかねぇ～♪
トロかなぁ～
かまかなぁ～
ヒレかなぁ～？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Will you cut that out already? Your tastes are so weird! I'm never 
eating a single bite of any monster! I gotta keep a close eye on you. 
Who knows what kind of weird meat you'll try to feed me... *grumble*
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたやめなさいよ、
その妙な趣味！
あたしは絶対に魔物なんか食べないからね！
見張ってなきゃ、
何の肉を食べさせられることか……
ぶつぶつ……
